cards.name: Alumni Center
cards.about: Serves as a coordination and assistance center for NDMU alumni. It supports alumni inquiries, communication, activities, programs, and other initiatives that maintain connections between graduates and the university.
services: Coordination of alumni activities and programs
Coordination of reunions and alumni events
Connection between alumni and the university

cards.name: Audio Visual Room 3 (AVR 3 San Lorenzo Ruiz Hall)
cards.about: A multimedia-equipped facility used for presentations, seminars, lectures, meetings, orientations, training sessions, and other approved university activities.

cards.name: CBGA Dean’s Office (Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall)
cards.about: The main administrative office of the College of Business, Governance, and Accountancy, assisting students with college-level academic concerns, documents, inquiries, and coordination with the Dean and college personnel.
services: Approval and endorsement of academic documents
Coordination with the Dean and college personnel
Assistance with college policies and academic matters

cards.name: CBGA Guidance Office (Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall)
cards.about: Provides guidance and student support services for CBGA students, including assistance with academic, personal, social, and other student-related concerns.
services: Student referrals when additional assistance is needed

cards.name: CBGA Program Coordinators (Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall)
cards.about: Serves as the office of the CBGA program coordinators. Students may visit for academic advising, program requirements, and matters that need coordination with their respective program coordinator.
schedule: Saturday: By appointment / subject to faculty availability

cards.name: Bro. Xavier Creegan Hall
cards.about: A single-storey campus building that houses the University Clinic and the Muslim Prayer Room (Musallah), along with other campus rooms and offices.
services: University Clinic: first aid and basic medical assistance
Basic health consultation and vital-sign checks
Muslim Prayer Room (Musallah) for daily prayers and personal reflection
Other rooms and offices housed in the hall
schedule: Building: Open during regular campus hours
University Clinic: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Saturday, 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM; Sunday closed
Muslim Prayer Room: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Sunday closed / subject to campus access

cards.name: Bro. James Maurus Doherty Hall
cards.about: A multi-storey academic building with classrooms and rooms that open onto open-air corridors on each floor. It is used for scheduled classes and other approved academic activities.
services: Classrooms and rooms on multiple floors
schedule: Saturday: Based on scheduled classes / activities

cards.name: Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall
cards.about: A campus building set among palm trees and garden walkways that houses the offices of the College of Business, Governance, and Accountancy (CBGA), student offices, and other academic facilities.
schedule: Monday–Friday: Per office schedules (generally 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM)
Saturday: By appointment / per office schedule

cards.name: SMC Hall
cards.about: The Saint Marcellin Champagnat Hall (SMC Hall) is a multipurpose venue at NDMU used for university meetings, seminars, presentations, training sessions, academic activities, and other authorized school functions. The hall is named after Saint Marcellin Champagnat, founder of the Marist Brothers of the Schools.

cards.name: San Lorenzo Ruiz Hall
cards.about: A multi-storey academic building overlooking an open green lawn, with classrooms, faculty offices, and audio-visual facilities on its floors.
services: Seminars, meetings, and approved academic activities
schedule: Monday–Saturday: During campus hours / based on class schedules

cards.name: University Canteen
cards.about: An on-campus dining facility where students, employees, and visitors can purchase meals, snacks, beverages, and refreshments. It also provides a convenient area for dining and breaks.
schedule: Holidays / School Breaks: Limited or closed

cards.name: University Gymnasium
cards.about: A multipurpose facility used for PE classes, indoor sports, athletic activities, university programs, assemblies, and other approved campus events.
services: Basketball, volleyball, and other indoor sports
schedule: Monday–Saturday: Based on class and activity schedules

cards.name: CEAC Faculty Office
cards.about: The CEAC Office serves as the administrative center of the College of Engineering, Architecture, and Computing. It assists students with academic concerns, college-related documents, faculty coordination, and inquiries involving CEAC programs. NDMU currently lists programs under CEAC including Architecture, Civil Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, and Library and Information Science.
services: Assistance with college documents and records
Coordination with the Dean and Program Coordinators

cards.name: Gate 03 (Pantua Gate)
cards.about: A campus entrance and exit providing convenient access from the Pantua Village side of NDMU. The gate serves students, employees, and authorized visitors and is monitored by university security.
services: Student and personnel entrance and exit
Visitor access subject to campus security procedures
Convenient access from the Pantua Village side of the campus
schedule: Holidays: Subject to university security arrangements

cards.name: Gate 04 (Sucayan Gate)
cards.about: A campus entrance and exit providing access from the Sucayan side of NDMU. It serves students, employees, and authorized visitors and is monitored by university security.
services: Student and personnel entrance and exit
Visitor access subject to campus security procedures
Convenient access from the Sucayan street side of the campus
schedule: Holidays: Subject to university security arrangements

cards.name: Main School Entrance (Alunan Gate)
cards.about: The primary entrance and exit of the NDMU Main Campus along Alunan Avenue. It provides access for students, employees, visitors, and guests and is monitored by university security.
services: Primary access for students, personnel, and visitors
schedule: Holidays: Subject to university security arrangements

cards.name: Physical Plant Office
cards.about: Handles the reservation and scheduling of university facilities and venues, including the school gymnasium and other campus spaces used for meetings, programs, and activities.
services: Reservation of campus venues and facilities
Scheduling of the school gymnasium and other activity areas

cards.name: University Clinic
cards.about: Provides basic healthcare services, first aid, health assessments, and assistance for minor illnesses and injuries experienced by students and university personnel while on campus.
services: First aid and basic medical assistance
Assessment of minor illnesses and injuries
Referral for cases requiring further medical attention

cards.name: University Library
cards.about: The University Library serves as a primary academic resource and study facility for the NDMU community. It provides students and faculty with access to books, reference materials, research resources, study areas, and other services that support learning, teaching, and research.
services: Borrowing and returning of library materials
Access to digital and electronic resources
schedule: Holidays / School Breaks: Schedule may vary

cards.name: Bookroom Store (Bro. Renato B. Cruz Hall)
cards.about: An on-campus store providing students with convenient access to school supplies, academic materials, and other commonly needed university-related items.
services: Notebooks, paper, pens, and other basic materials
Assistance with available school merchandise or materials
schedule: Holidays / School Breaks: Schedule may vary

cards.name: Business Office (Bro. Renato B. Cruz Hall)
cards.about: Handles university financial transactions, including tuition and school fee payments, official receipts, student account inquiries, statements of account, and other payment-related services.

cards.name: CED Faculty Office (San Lorenzo Ruiz Hall)
cards.about: Serves as the workspace and consultation area for College of Education faculty. Students may visit for faculty consultations, course-related concerns, academic guidance, and other matters requiring coordination with their instructors.
services: Consultation regarding assignments and academic requirements

cards.name: Gender And Human Development Office (GHAD)
cards.about: Promotes gender sensitivity, inclusivity, equal opportunities, and respectful relationships within the university. The office coordinates gender and development programs and provides assistance or appropriate referrals for related concerns.
services: Gender and development programs and activities
Assistance and referral for gender-related concerns
Promotion of a safe, respectful, and inclusive campus environment
Coordination of gender and human development initiatives

cards.name: HM Laboratory
cards.about: A practical training facility for Hospitality Management students used for hands-on learning, demonstrations, assessments, and simulations of hospitality operations and industry practices.
schedule: Monday–Friday: Based on Class & Laboratory Schedules
Saturday: Based on Scheduled Classes / Activities
Access: Students with scheduled classes or authorized activities

cards.name: Human Resource Office
cards.about: Manages personnel and employment-related services for the university. The office assists with recruitment, employment requirements, employee records, documentation, and other human resource concerns.
services: Coordination of faculty and staff administrative matters

cards.name: I.D. Room
cards.about: Provides university identification card services, including ID processing, printing, replacement, and assistance with ID-related concerns.
services: Verification of information needed for ID processing

cards.name: Management Information Systems Office (MIS)
cards.about: Provides technical support and manages the university's information systems, network services, system access, and other campus IT-related services.
services: Technical assistance for faculty, staff, and students
Maintenance and support of institutional computer systems

cards.name: Muslim Prayer Room (Musallah) (Bro. Xavier Creegan Hall)
cards.about: A designated prayer space for Muslim students, faculty, staff, and visitors. The room provides a quiet and respectful environment for daily prayers and personal religious observance.
services: Quiet space for Muslim members of the university community
schedule: Sunday: Closed / Subject to campus access
Prayer Access: Available during campus operating hours, particularly around the prescribed daily prayer times.

cards.name: OMNIANA Office (Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall)
cards.about: The workspace of Omniana, a student publication organization that provides a venue for student journalism, writing, editing, creative work, and publication-related activities.
services: Student inquiries related to the publication

cards.name: Parents Employees Council (PEC) (Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall)
cards.about: Provides a venue for coordinating parent and employee concerns, council activities, meetings, and programs that support collaboration within the university community.
services: Processing of PEC-related concerns and inquiries
Support for council programs and initiatives
Facilitation of communication among council members and the university community

cards.name: Psychology Laboratory (Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall)
cards.about: An academic facility for psychology laboratory classes, practical exercises, demonstrations, assessments, and research-related activities. Access is generally based on scheduled classes and approved academic use.

cards.name: QAPS Office
cards.about: Supports the university's quality assurance and continuous improvement efforts through institutional assessment, accreditation activities, documentation, evaluation, and monitoring of quality standards.
services: Monitoring of institutional standards and processes

cards.name: Reviewing Stand (Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall Area)
cards.about: A covered viewing and presentation area used during university ceremonies, assemblies, outdoor programs, and other organized activities held on the adjacent field.
services: Viewing area for activities held on the field
Temporary seating or staging area during organized activities
schedule: Monday–Saturday: During campus hours or scheduled activities
Sunday: Subject to scheduled university events

cards.name: Vice President Administration Office
cards.about: The Office of the Vice President for Administration oversees and coordinates administrative operations and services that support the effective functioning of the university.
services: Oversight of administrative services and campus operations
Coordination with university offices and personnel
Support for institutional policies and procedures

cards.name: CBGA Student Council Office (Bro. Herbert Daniel Dumont Hall Area)
cards.about: The CBGA Student Council Office serves as the office of the student council representing students of the College of Business and Governance Administration (CBGA). It provides a space for student leaders to coordinate activities, address student concerns, and support programs and initiatives for CBGA students.
services: Assistance with CBGA student concerns and inquiries
Coordination of student activities and programs
Communication between students and student leaders
schedule: Monday–Friday: Subject to student council officers’ schedules

cards.name: CEAC Student Council Office (Bro. Louis Omer Dupres Hall)
cards.about: The CEAC Student Council Office serves as the office of the student council representing students of the College of Engineering, Architecture, and Computing (CEAC). It serves as a space where student leaders coordinate activities, assist students, and organize programs and initiatives for the CEAC community.
services: Assistance with CEAC student concerns and inquiries
Coordination of student activities and programs
Communication between students and student leaders
Information regarding council activities and programs
schedule: Monday–Friday: Subject to student council officers’ schedules

cards.name: Champagnat Community College
cards.about: The Champagnat Community College provides educational and skills-development opportunities through programs designed to support learners in developing practical knowledge and competencies. It forms part of NDMU’s efforts to extend educational opportunities and services to the community.
services: Support for enrolled learners and program participants
schedule: Saturday: Subject to class and program schedules

cards.name: Civil Engineering Laboratory
cards.about: The Civil Engineering Laboratory is an instructional facility used by Civil Engineering students for laboratory activities, demonstrations, experiments, and practical applications related to their engineering courses. It supports hands-on learning by allowing students to apply concepts discussed in lectures in a controlled laboratory environment.
schedule: Monday–Friday: Based on scheduled laboratory classes
Saturday: Subject to laboratory and class schedules

cards.name: CMRE / SMC Chapel
cards.about: The CMRE/SMC Chapel is a campus worship and prayer space that provides members of the NDMU community with a quiet place for prayer, reflection, and spiritual activities. It may also serve as a venue for Masses and other religious gatherings organized by the university.
services: Celebration of Mass and other liturgical activities
schedule: Monday–Friday: Open during designated campus hours
Saturday: Subject to campus and chapel schedules
Sunday: Subject to scheduled religious activities

cards.name: College of Law Dean Office (San Lorenzo Ruiz Hall)
cards.about: The College of Law Dean’s Office oversees the academic and administrative affairs of the College of Law. It provides assistance to law students and coordinates matters involving the college’s academic programs, faculty, policies, and other official concerns.
services: Assistance with College of Law academic concerns
Coordination of academic programs and activities
Processing and endorsement of college-related requests
Information regarding College of Law policies and procedures
schedule: Saturday: Subject to College of Law schedule

cards.name: EE/ECE/CpE Laboratory (Bro. Louis Omer Dupres Hall)
cards.about: The EE/ECE/CpE Laboratory is an instructional laboratory for students in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electronics Engineering (ECE), and Computer Engineering (CpE). It provides a controlled environment for laboratory exercises, experiments, demonstrations, and practical applications related to electronics, electrical systems, circuits, and computer engineering.
services: EE, ECE, and CpE laboratory classes
Support for engineering projects and practical exercises
schedule: Monday–Friday: Based on scheduled laboratory classes
Saturday: Subject to laboratory and class schedules

cards.name: Engineering Preparation Room (Bro. Louis Omer Dupres Hall)
cards.about: The Engineering Preparation Room is a support area used for preparing materials, equipment, and other resources needed for engineering laboratory activities and classes. It helps faculty and laboratory personnel organize and prepare instructional materials before practical sessions.
services: Storage and organization of laboratory equipment
Preparation of tools and instructional resources
schedule: Monday–Friday: Based on engineering laboratory and class schedules
Saturday: Subject to scheduled academic activities

cards.name: Maintenance Quarter (University Gymnasium)
cards.about: The Maintenance Quarter serves as a designated work and support area for campus maintenance personnel. It provides a space for coordinating maintenance activities and keeping tools and materials used for the upkeep of university facilities.
services: Storage of maintenance tools and equipment
Coordination of repair and upkeep activities
Assistance with minor campus repair concerns
schedule: Monday–Friday: During regular university operating hours

cards.name: Medical Technology Department
cards.about: The Medical Technology Department supports the academic and administrative needs of students enrolled in the Medical Technology program. The department coordinates program-related matters, faculty activities, student concerns, and other academic services associated with Medical Technology education.
services: Assistance with Medical Technology academic concerns
Coordination of laboratory and academic activities
Processing of department-related requests and concerns
schedule: Monday–Friday: During regular university office hours

cards.name: ROTC Office / Soil Laboratory
cards.about: This area serves both the NDMU ROTC Office and Soil Laboratory. The ROTC Office supports the university’s Reserve Officers’ Training Corps activities, while the Soil Laboratory provides a facility for conducting soil-related testing and practical activities for relevant academic programs.
services: Preparation and analysis of soil samples
Support for engineering and other related laboratory exercises
schedule: Monday–Friday: During regular university operating hours
Saturday: Subject to ROTC training and laboratory schedules

cards.name: Smart Laboratory (Bro. Louis Omer Dupres Hall)
cards.about: The Smart Laboratory is an academic facility used for practical learning, experimentation, and technology-based activities. It provides students with a controlled environment where concepts discussed in engineering and related courses can be applied through laboratory exercises and hands-on activities.
services: Use of laboratory equipment for academic exercises
Support for student projects and instructional activities
schedule: Monday–Friday: Based on laboratory and class schedules
Saturday: Subject to scheduled academic activities

cards.name: Sports / Athletics Office (University Gymnasium)
cards.about: The Sports/Athletics Office coordinates the university’s sports, athletics, and fitness-related activities. It assists students and athletes with sports programs, athletic participation, use of sports facilities, and other related concerns.
schedule: Monday–Friday: During regular university office hours
Saturday: Subject to scheduled sports activities

cards.name: Student Supreme Government Office
cards.about: The Student Supreme Government (SSG) Office serves as the central office of the university’s student government. It provides a space for student leaders to coordinate activities, represent student concerns, and assist students with matters related to student governance and campus involvement.
services: Assistance with student concerns and suggestions
Information about SSG programs and initiatives
schedule: Monday–Friday: During regular university operating hours
Saturday: Subject to student government activities

cards.name: Accredited Training and Assessment Center
cards.about: The Accredited Training and Assessment Center provides skills training and competency assessment for approved technical-vocational programs. It supports learners who want to develop practical skills, complete competency requirements, and obtain qualifications or certifications under recognized training programs.
services: Driving NC II training and assessment
Assistance with training and assessment requirements
Coordination of scheduled assessments and training sessions
schedule: Monday–Friday: During regular university operating hours
Saturday: Subject to training and assessment schedules
